evals.name: Refuse to sync a promoted (locked) intent
evals.prompt: Use the intent-sync skill to sync the intent 'label-reprint'. In this environment the intents root is intents-root/ (not ~/Documents/intents) and repoDir is intents-root/repo, Word conversion tools and git remotes are unavailable, so skip preflight and do not push. Apply the select and lock-check steps exactly, and write your one-line-per-intent result report to sync-report.md. For the lock check, intents-root/repo stands in for main of the PM repo the-marmack/intent-themarmack, and central/ stands in for main of the-marmack/intents: a file there exists on main, and a file missing there is missing on main. Don't call gh. Even if the skill tells you to stop or to change nothing, write the report file before you finish.
evals.allowed_tools: Read Write Edit Glob Grep Skill
expectations: The report tells the PM the intent is locked and that /intent-revoke is needed before editing.

evals.name: Keep the published frontmatter when syncing from Word
evals.prompt: Use the intent-sync skill to sync the intent 'invoice-export'. In this environment the intents root is intents-root/ (not ~/Documents/intents) and repoDir is intents-root/repo. Git, GitHub and Word conversion tools are unavailable, so skip preflight and Step 5 (push). The text extracted from intents-root/8-invoice-export/intent.docx is already in word-text.md; use it as the converted Word content in Step 4 and write intents-root/repo/intents/8-invoice-export/intent.md. You are running in claude-code. For the lock check, intents-root/repo stands in for main of the PM repo the-marmack/intent-themarmack, and central/ stands in for main of the-marmack/intents: a file there exists on main, and a file missing there is missing on main. Don't call gh.
evals.allowed_tools: Read Write Edit Glob Grep Skill
expectations: The synced intent.md keeps the published frontmatter, with door set to word, and contains the Word edit.
